purpose: Track online artifacts that are relevant evidence but are hosted outside this GitHub repository.

artifacts.role_in_repo: External online artifact referenced as part of the public research trail.
limitations: The fetched page is a dynamic Claude artifact shell with noindex/nofollow metadata.
The artifact body was not imported into the repo in this pass; only the stable URL and observed accessibility were recorded.
Because the artifact is externally hosted, availability and access may change outside this repository.
